commit.message:
RISC-V: Add scalar Zbc (carry-less multiply) fast path for CRC32 intrinsic

Use scalar carry-less multiplication (Zbc) to fold CRC32 input in
16-byte blocks while retaining the existing table fallback for short
inputs and the trailing remainder. Prefer the RVV path for sufficiently
large inputs and route inputs of 128 bytes or more through the scalar Zbc
path otherwise. The Zbc dispatch uses a far branch so it remains correct
when RVC is disabled.

Report the CRC32 intrinsic as supported on Zbc-only systems in addition
to Zba or RVV, so it is no longer force-disabled there when requested.

Add boundary and mode coverage (TestCRC32RiscvZbc), including scalar Zbc,
Zbc+RVV, and the RVC-disabled mixed RVV/Zbc mode that exercises the
far-branch dispatch.
